title: After the SPA moved to access tokens, other tenants see Acme's shipments
scenario: Brightline Health (SAML) and Corvid Logistics (OIDC) see Acme Foods' shipments in Tidewater Ask since this morning; Acme users see nothing wrong. Brightline rotated its SAML signing certificate last night. The SPA started sending access tokens instead of ID tokens to the API the same morning.
task: Show what the ID and access tokens carry and how the Lambda resolved the tenant
Rule the SAML certificate rotation in or out with evidence
Fix the user pool trigger version, the trigger response and the resolver; keep access tokens
Write the exposure statement and the rollout order
acceptance: V2_0 trigger adds tenant_id to both tokens; unmapped users cannot sign in
No default tenant; requests without a tenant claim get 403
Every pilot user served only their own tenant

practices.label: Week 4 Mon - Cognito user pools and federation
Week 4 Tue - pre token generation trigger
Week 4 Wed - JWT authorizers and tenant claims
